description: The page the shell carries — «CanonKeeper запускается…», the steps of a long start and the failure window (specs/2026-11-13-desk-upgrade.md UG3) — reads its state and does the acts of the failure it shows: the data folder, the contact page of the site, the release of a version, the folder of the copy, the return of the data from the copy, closing the app. None of its commands takes a name, a path or an address. The page of the backend gets its own capability for its exact origin when the backend is ready.
